abstract: A gastric choriocarcinoma cell line capable of producing human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) was studied by sc transplantation and serial passages into nude mice fed under specific pathogen-free (SPF) conditions. The tumor-take rate at the serial heterotransplantation in SPF mice was high (greater than 95%), in contrast with a low rate in coventional animals (35%). The restoration of morphology and function of the original neoplasm were exclusively verified in SPF mice. Multiple lung metastases were found in 2 animals. The production, storage, and excretion of HCG by tumor cells were confirmed by its high content in serum and cystic fluid in tumors and by its intracellular localization. The tumor cells also contained a specific placental alkaline phosphatase in their membranes. The cells were various trophoblastic types ranging from primitive cytotrophoblasts to typical syncytial cells. The hormone effects of the tumor on sex organs of tumor-bearing animals were evident.
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を産生する胃絨毛癌細胞株を、特定病原体除去（SPF）条件下で飼育したヌードマウスへの皮下移植および連続継代により検討した。SPFマウスでは移植生着率が95%超と高く、従来型動物では35%と低率であった。原腫瘍の形態と機能の再現はSPFマウスでのみ確認された。2匹で多発性肺転移が認められた。腫瘍細胞によるhCGの産生、貯蔵および排泄は、血清・腫瘍嚢胞液中の高濃度と細胞内局在により確認された。腫瘍細胞膜には胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼも存在した。細胞は原始的細胞性栄養膜細胞から典型的な合胞体細胞まで多様な栄養膜細胞型からなっていた。腫瘍が担癌動物の性器に及ぼすホルモン作用も明らかであった。
